title: Missing test coverage for route '/status-react'

evidence.quote:
<Route path="/status" element={<StatusPage />} />
        {/* HTML version (Hendrix) at /status-html or linked from React version */}
        <Route path="/status-react" element={<StatusPage />} />

reasoning: Both /status and /status-react routes render the same StatusPage component. The feature metadata lists /status-react as the entrypoint, but no tests validate either route, the component lifecycle (mount, interval, refresh), or the status aggregation logic in OverallBanner and GroupCard.
recommendation: Add integration tests that render StatusPage via both routes, verify initial 'checking' state, simulate status updates, test refresh button, validate auto-refresh interval, and assert correct status badge colors and labels for all StatusLevel combinations.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Feature metadata shows no tests. No test files were provided for review.
suggestedRegressionTest: React Testing Library test suite: 1) mount StatusPage, 2) verify initial 'checking' state, 3) mock simulateCheck, 4) advance timers and verify status updates, 5) click refresh and verify re-check, 6) verify interval fires every 60s, 7) test all status combinations (operational/degraded/outage) render correct badges.
